The judge's defect was step 6's 'Kampvliet at 94' against 93.45 recomputed under all five constructions of that basis; the generator's own ladder.pre gave 93.5531, which rounds to 94, so the generator and the pack disagreed by 0.099 across a rounding boundary. Rather than move the figure, the four rejected-route percentages were cut from the graded surface: blocks 1 and 3 now name the site each wrong basis puts furthest below contract and print no percentage for it, which removes four figures that sat 0.13 to 0.30 of a unit from flipping (period setpoint 57.63, undisturbed level 76.82 and 93.55). The claim that Kampvliet sits inside tolerance on both bases was drafted and then dropped as false: on the period setpoint it is 68.37, outside tolerance but not the lowest, so the text now says neither basis names it for the slot. Step 3's traverse criterion was reworded in both places from 'boundaries where no qualifying episode ran', which is contaminated by sub-threshold droop response and returns 70 to 72 s for Nieuwveen, to 'boundaries at which the site held no reserve commitment', which the judge recovered unanimously per site. metadata.json now declares prequalification_records.csv as the one wrong-basis distractor, ruled out by clause 2 of the standard (realised response at the extreme second of each qualifying episode) and clause 3 (the window of 21 September to 11 October 2026); measured over contracted step-test gain ranks all nine sites, puts Reiderland lowest at 98.5 per cent and names no withdrawal. The technical conditions' line promising one-second publication for every deviation beyond 75 millihertz was qualified to sustained deviations where the high-resolution record is available, because 62 of the 646 minutes whose minimum is at or below 49.925 Hz carry no one-second sample, so the document contradicted its own pack. figures.json gained five keys the generator now computes (spans, obliged_pairs, episodes_total, sites_outside_tolerance, constants) which had been hand-added and were dropped by the rebuild, failing figures_check on four figures. Two realism items are now measured and closed rather than open: the qualifying episodes carry 65 distinct durations from 15 to 295 s and 37 distinct lags from 41 to 545 s, with 164 of 274 in the 41 to 90 s band and episodes in 274 of 1,978 quarter-hours, and the archive's FREQ-DEV recordings carry 73 distinct sample counts and 68 distinct start offsets, so the uniformity this number was held for is not in the shipped pack.
